payload.topic: I'd need a system to dump my unrefined ideas and help me move them forward. I have a thousand thoughts in a day that I do nothing about. Sometimes there are repeated themes but often I think about something just to forget about it and remind after weeks or months. Ideally I could make a quick note - text or voice - and hand it over to a group of agents to do research, criticize, ask questions and answer them, find connections to my earlier ideas - in general - refine. Then I could go back to those refined ideas at the end of the day or maybe once a week and steer the agent further - set direction for a deeper research or planning or to build the idea autonomously if it's a web/mobile app or some kind of information system. Often my ideas are about that. For these, I'd like the agent to generate tasks, acceptance criteria, testing and code review pipelines, and loop until it's done. Sometimes these ideas touch physical stuff and real world problems - in this case a memorized outcome would be enough so I can go back to it at - so the memory aspect is important too.
